quality_metrics.collected_by: United States Department of Agriculture| Agricultural Research Service WRRC

curation.notes: GenomeTrakr isolate ISO000128536 (SEQSEQ000130868). Strain RM13485. Isolation: feral pig from porcine (2010). Assembly not available - generate locally.

mlst.notes: ST11 is the dominant O157:H7 lineage

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR24226263 && mv data/SRR24226263_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR24226263_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.notes: Assembly not available in NCBI. Generate locally: spades.py -1 data/reads_1.fq.gz -2 data/reads_2.fq.gz -o assembly/ --careful && cp assembly/contigs.fasta data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype O157:H7. Accept exact match 'O157:H7' or individual O/H antigen calls that match. Serotype confirmed in GenomeTrakr GIMS database (ISOISO000128536). Tool should confidently call this serotype.
validation_instructions.virulence: Expected STEC virulence genes: stx1, stx2, eae, ehxA. At minimum, stx (Shiga toxin) and eae (intimin) should be detected for typical STEC. Accept PASS if all expected genes found. PARTIAL if stx present but other genes missing.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST11 (dominant O157:H7 lineage). Accept exact ST11 match. Other STs unusual for O157:H7.

notes: Classic STEC serotype, major cause of HUS. ST11 is the dominant lineage.
